name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer headquartered in Reno, Nevada, focused on acquiring and exploring gold-bearing mineral properties in Nevada. Its primary active project is the Lapon Canyon Gold Project, where 2026 drilling returned intercepts up to 3.97 g/t gold over 85 metres. The company also holds interests in the Agai-Pah, Swales, Loman, and Belshazzar properties across various Nevada gold districts.
